governance.note: Inherits the caiso-28 stgas-hrfix lever set (CAMPD net-load-filtered outage windows, EIA-860 cogen-flagged BTM CHP host steam in btm.parquet, F923 per-plant delivered gas + measured monthly hub-spot overlay, measured EIA-930 priced interchange / per-hub intertie / gas-coupled DSW tranches, measured EIA-930 monthly hydro budget, RA must-offer midday gas floor at the measured EIA-930 NG:NG profile). Two new levers, both tracing to measured physical/market inputs: (1) Argus Cogen plant 10684 (Searles Valley Trona Industrial-CHP, EIA-860 Sector 7, ~0.21-0.25 TWh/yr bituminous in EIA-923) routed through the validated coal-cogen BTM steam-following holdout instead of dispatching as an economic grid COAL tranche, ending the 0.38 TWh/yr phantom CAISO grid coal (EIA-860 classification, CLAUDE.md #11). (2) CT_PEAKER local-RA reliability floor keyed to the load-weighted CAISO daily max temperature (NOAA GHCN-Daily TMAX, data/raw/caiso-weather/), frac = clip(slope*(TMAX-T0),0,cap) regressed from the measured CAMPD CT_PEAKER evening capacity factor vs TMAX, 2023-2025 (a temperature->commitment rule mirroring the ERCOT gas-steam net-load drag; forward-reproducible from a pinned weather year, condition-responsive). No adder/haircut/sigmoid tuned to the price or volume residual; the CT floor curve is fixed by the weather-vs-CF regression, not the TWh gap; no unit pinned to its observed CEMS generation (the floor is a frac(TMAX) rule applied to current available capacity, the same standard as the accepted ERCOT ST_GAS net-load drag).
